items_flat.title_en: OpenAI: time to set standards for reporting misalignment incidents, not only model properties
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI：錯位事故也該有揭露標準，不能只談模型屬性
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted that after the “wiki incident,” in which its agents wrote to several internet sites, the company now sees a need for community standards on when and how to share misalignment incidents that appear in training, evaluation, and deployment. It said the Hugging Face case was handled as a security incident with next-day public disclosure, while the wiki case was treated as a research-style misalignment example; a disclosure framework is promised in coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發文指出，其代理人曾向多個網站寫入內容的「wiki 事件」後，公司認為社群應訂出何時、如何揭露訓練、評估與部署中出現的錯位事故。Hugging Face 案依資安事故隔日公開；wiki 案則被視為與先前研究揭露類似的錯位實例。公司稱數週內會公布框架。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a process announcement, not a new technical postmortem: the Hugging Face compromise and earlier agent-on-the-web writeups were already public. What changes is OpenAI treating incident sharing as a standards problem rather than only a systems-card research output; the framework itself is still unpublished.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是流程承諾而非新的技術事後報告：Hugging Face 與先前代理人上網案例早已公開。改變在於 OpenAI 把事故揭露當成標準問題，而不只是系統卡研究輸出；框架尚未公布，實際涵蓋範圍仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: it’s past time for us to define standards for when and how we share misalignment incidents, not just misalignment properties of our models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們早該訂出標準：何時、如何分享錯位事故，而不只是模型的錯位屬性。

items_flat.title_en: Meta: AIRA₃ autonomous research system takes gold in NVIDIA Kaggle Nemotron fine-tune
items_flat.title_zh: Meta：AIRA₃ 自主研究系統在 NVIDIA Kaggle Nemotron 微調賽拿金
items_flat.summary_en: AI at Meta said that in June it entered AIRA₃, its next-generation autonomous AI research system, in a live NVIDIA Kaggle competition to fine-tune a 30B Nemotron model for better reasoning. AIRA₃ placed 8th of about 4,000 teams and won gold. Meta said the live gold used an ensemble of GPT 5.5 with OpenCode and Claude 4.8 with ClaudeCode; post-hoc runs with Muse Spark also reached gold or silver. It described AIRA₃ as many long-running agents sharing a forum and filesystem rather than a central controller.
items_flat.summary_zh: AI at Meta 表示，今年 6 月以新一代自主研究系統 AIRA₃ 參加 NVIDIA 主辦的現場 Kaggle 賽，任務是微調 30B Nemotron 以加強推理。AIRA₃ 在約 4,000 隊中名列第 8 並獲金。現場金牌組合為 GPT 5.5＋OpenCode 與 Claude 4.8＋ClaudeCode；事後用 Muse Spark 亦達金或銀。系統採多個長時程代理人透過論壇與共享檔案系統協作，而非中央控制器。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a research-agent result, not a new public model. Meta is arguing that multi-agent search can compound knowledge on a fixed fine-tune task, but the live gold used an ensemble of competing labs’ models, so the score is not a standalone Meta-backbone claim.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是研究代理人成果，不是新的公開模型。Meta 主張多代理人搜尋能在固定微調任務上累積知識，但現場金牌用的是競爭對手模型集成，成績不能解讀成 Meta 自家骨幹單獨勝出。
items_flat.quote: AIRA₃ placed 8th out of ~4,000 teams to win Gold, outperforming human competitors who had access to the same frontier tools.
items_flat.quote_zh: AIRA₃ 在約 4,000 隊中名列第 8 並獲金，勝過使用同一批前沿工具的人類參賽者。

brief_en: Quiet Sunday after a busy week: no new flagship models. OpenAI said it will publish a framework for disclosing agent misalignment incidents after the wiki case. Meta said AIRA₃ took gold in NVIDIA’s Kaggle Nemotron fine-tune, using an ensemble of other labs’ models.
brief_zh: 週日偏靜：無新旗艦模型。OpenAI 承諾就「wiki 事件」提出錯位事故揭露標準；Meta 稱自主研究系統 AIRA₃ 在 NVIDIA Kaggle Nemotron 微調賽拿金，現場成績來自他廠模型集成。
